entries.reason: Single Responsibility — The spec addresses the single user-defined concern of enforcing task-scoped implementation flow with an explicit audited broad-mode exception.; Task Single Responsibility — Each task has a focused goal tied to task cursor enforcement, broad mode, task-scoped gates, reporting, or regression coverage.; Unambiguous Requirements — The requirements state concrete conditions, command behavior, inputs, outputs, and stored fields rather than relying on vague adjectives.; Complete Context — Each requirement includes enough concrete state, command, and output detail for reviewers to judge whether an implementation satisfies it.; REQ Diff-Verifiability — The requirements describe behavior, prompt inputs, stored audit fields, and report output that can be checked from implementation diff plus test execution summary.; No Hardcoded Secrets — The content is a specification and contains no API keys, passwords, tokens, or other secrets.; No Silent Error Swallowing — The content does not introduce code with empty catch blocks or silent error discarding.; Prioritize Requirements — There are more than three requirements, and each requirement includes a priority value of must or should.; Impact on Existing Features — missing impact list for existing features — The guardrail requires changes to list their impact on existing features or state explicitly that none are affected. (at spec.json); Bounded Resource Usage — The spec does not propose recursive processing, retries, or bulk data loading designs requiring explicit bounds.; Spec Includes Test Strategy — The spec includes test strategy details in each task and acceptance coverage for targeted tests and npm test execution.; Record Unresolved Points as Open Questions — The Open Questions section is present and empty, indicating no unresolved points are being fabricated.; Include 'Why This Approach' Rationale — The overview decisions and alternatives_considered sections explain why the task cursor enforcement and audited broad-mode approach were chosen.; Spec Test Coverage — The spec requires spec-local tests under specs/258-task-scoped-impl-flow/tests with spec requirement headers in task T-5.; Backward-Compatible CLI Interface — The acknowledged exception cites backward-compatible-cli-interface in constraints and includes a migration plan through recovery and explicit broad-mode command output.; Exit Code Contract — The acknowledged exception cites exit-code-contract in constraints and states success/failure behavior with ok:false envelopes and non-zero exits for null cursor violations without broad mode.; Validate User Input at Entry Point — The spec lists the broad-mode user-facing argument validation requirements, including non-empty reason, unknown task id rejection, and entry-point validation.
